args.sql:
SELECT 
    dp.profileTrace AS profile_id,
    dp.vol_gb * CASE 
        WHEN dp.dataSense IN ('Critical', 'High') THEN 3 
        WHEN dp.dataSense = 'Medium' THEN 2 
        ELSE 1 
    END AS sensitivity_score,
    CASE 
        WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' AND sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3 
        WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' OR sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2 
        ELSE 1 
    END AS security_score
FROM DataProfile dp
JOIN SecurityProfile sp ON dp.profileTrace = sp.profile_key
WHERE 
    dp.vol_gb * CASE 
        WHEN dp.dataSense IN ('Critical', 'High') THEN 3 
        WHEN dp.dataSense = 'Medium' THEN 2 
        ELSE 1 
    END > 100
    AND (CASE 
        WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' AND sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 3 
        WHEN sp.enc_state = 'Full' OR sp.acl_state = 'Strong' THEN 2 
        ELSE 1 
    END) < 2
ORDER BY sensitivity_score DESC
LIMIT 5;
